headlines.title: 商务部：外国企业对特定二次圆柱形电池、电池组件及包含该组件的产品提起337调查申请
headlines.summary: 7月21日，韩国LG Energy Solution Ltd.、美国LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc.根据《美国1930年关税法》第337节规定，向美国国际贸易委员会提出申请，指控对美出口、在美进口或在美销售的特定二次圆柱形电池、电池组件及包含该组件的产品（Certain Secondary Cylindrical Batteries, Components Thereof, and Products Containing the Same）侵犯其专利权，请求发起337调查并发布有限排除令和禁止令。其中，中国三家企业涉案。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Foreign companies file 337 investigation application on certain secondary cylindrical batteries, battery components, and products containing such components
headlines.summary_en: On July 21, Korea's LG Energy Solution Ltd. and U.S.-based LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. filed a petition with the U.S. International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain secondary cylindrical batteries, components thereof, and products containing the same exported to, imported into, or sold in the U.S. infringe their patents, requesting a Section 337 investigation and issuance of a limited exclusion order and cease and desist order. Three Chinese companies are involved.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title: 摩根大通：AI板块不太可能是下半年回报的主要驱动力
headlines.summary: 摩根大通策略师认为，随着市场表现向更多板块扩散，科技股或人工智能相关股票下半年不太可能是市场回报的主要驱动力。由Mislav Matejka带领的团队表示，动量交易的抛售可能大部分已经结束，半导体股目前已接近超卖水平该团队在报告中写道：“由于每股收益动能依然向上，这应有助于相关股票企稳”。不过，其预计市场表现将继续向更多板块扩散，并重申，由于地缘政治局势紧张，建议投资者逢低买入。

headlines.title_en: JPMorgan: AI sector unlikely to be main driver of returns in second half
headlines.summary_en: JPMorgan strategists believe that as market performance broadens across more sectors, technology stocks or AI-related stocks are unlikely to be the main driver of market returns in the second half of the year. The team led by Mislav Matejka said the sell-off in momentum trades may be largely over, and semiconductor stocks are now near oversold levels. The team wrote in a report, 'With EPS momentum still pointing upward, this should help related stocks stabilize.' However, they expect market performance to continue broadening across sectors and reiterated a recommendation for investors to buy on dips due to geopolitical tensions.

headlines.summary: 8月3日，香港交易所正式推出全球首个离岸中国国债期货产品——5年期中国国债期货，首批上市的9月及12月两个季月合约同步开始交易。这是全球离岸市场首只以中国国债为标的的期货产品，全程以人民币计价、交易及结算，同时支持香港公众假期交易。

headlines.title_en: HKEX launches world's first offshore government bond futures, filling gap in foreign investors' cross-border hedging tools
headlines.summary_en: On August 3, Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing officially launched the world's first offshore Chinese government bond futures product - the 5-year Chinese government bond futures, with the first batch of September and December quarterly contracts beginning trading simultaneously. This is the first futures product in the global offshore market targeting Chinese government bonds, denominated, traded, and settled entirely in RMB, and also supports trading on Hong Kong public holidays.

headlines.summary:
China’s factory activity has slipped into contraction in July, ending a four-month growth streak as weaker new orders and persistent demand challenges highlight the need for further policy support from Beijing, analysts said.
The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) fell to 49.2 in July, down from 50.3 in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Friday. The reading fell short of the 50.11 projection from economists polled by the financial data...
headlines.title_zh: 中国制造业7月动能降温，增长势头放缓
headlines.summary_zh: 分析师表示，中国7月工厂活动陷入收缩，结束了连续四个月的增长态势，新订单疲软和持续的需求挑战凸显出北京方面需要进一步加大政策支持力度。数据显示，7月制造业采购经理指数（PMI）从6月的50.3降至49.2。

headlines.title_en: Fed's Williams: Fed policy will not be constrained by markets; optimistic on AI prospects
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 3 - When asked whether the Federal Reserve would be constrained by market levels in setting monetary policy, Fed's Williams replied, 'Absolutely not,' despite the central bank closely monitoring financial markets. Williams said, 'We must always conduct independent analysis, do our work carefully, and assess all factors affecting the economy and outlook.' Additionally, Williams holds a positive view on AI development and said some recent ups and downs in the industry are not surprising. He noted that asset price volatility 'comes with this highly innovative, fast-changing world, and we have seen similar situations before.' Regarding companies borrowing to expand operations, he said current leverage levels differ from those that led to the financial crisis two decades ago. 'These companies are highly profitable, so I am not too worried about financial stability risks from leverage right now.'

headlines.title_en: New liquidity management requirements for cross-border and cross-currency businesses! New rules for brokerage liquidity management

headlines.title_en: By end of 2025, China's financial leasing industry total assets reach 5.23 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 3 - According to the latest 'China Financial Leasing Industry Development Report (2026)' released by the China Banking Association, as of the end of 2025, there were 64 financial leasing companies in China, with total industry assets of 5.23 trillion yuan, up 7.89% year-on-year. The industry's non-performing leased asset ratio was 0.91%. The industry's asset scale is steadily expanding, operational stability is continuously strengthening, and overall risk resilience is steadily improving. The report shows that in 2025, the financial leasing industry focused its business layout on core needs of equipment renewal and manufacturing transformation and upgrading, continuously injecting financial momentum into manufacturing transformation. As of end-2025, the balance of direct leasing assets in the financial leasing industry was 1.84 trillion yuan, up 21.05% year-on-year. In addition, the financial leasing industry actively explored leasing application scenarios in emerging industries such as commercial aerospace and the low-altitude economy.

headlines.title_en: Li Qiang signs State Council decree issuing revised 'Integrated Circuit Layout Design Protection Regulations'
headlines.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang recently signed a State Council decree promulgating the revised Regulations on the Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs, effective from October 15, 2026. The regulations aim to protect exclusive rights in integrated circuit layout designs, encourage innovation in IC technology, and promote scientific and technological development. The regulations consist of 6 chapters and 54 articles, with the main revisions as follows. First, clarifying overall requirements: IC layout design protection work should implement the Party and state's intellectual property strategic deployment, expand the scope of protection, and emphasize good faith.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance, together with Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and Ministry of Water Resources, allocates 2.154 billion yuan for agricultural disaster prevention and water conservancy relief
headlines.summary_en: According to CCTV, in implementing the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, the Ministry of Finance, together with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and the Ministry of Water Resources, recently allocated 2.154 billion yuan in agricultural disaster prevention, mitigation, and water conservancy disaster relief funds. First, supporting six provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities) including Guangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Guangdong, Chongqing, and Guizhou in carrying out flood and earthquake disaster relief work such as repairing damaged water conservancy facilities, helping ensure safe operation of water conservancy projects. Second, supporting five provinces (autonomous regions) including Liaoning, Jilin, Zhejiang, Guangxi, and Hubei in post-disaster production recovery work such as water and fertilizer management for standing crops, replanting and reseeding on failed plots, restocking livestock and aquaculture, and repairing damaged facilities. Third, supporting three provinces (autonomous regions) including Shanxi, Xinjiang, and Gansu in promptly carrying out post-disaster relief work from floods, hail, and wind disasters, including crop replanting and restocking livestock, to accelerate agricultural production recovery. Fourth, focusing on the integration of prevention and rescue, supporting Hebei, Inner Mongolia, and Jilin.

headlines.title: 联合国工发组织食品行业检验检测能力建设与提升培训计划收官
headlines.summary: 记者今天了解到，市场监管总局（国家认监委）与联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）联合指导实施的“提质护航·丝路共信”食品行业检验检测能力建设与提升培训计划在北京收官。该培训计划旨在深入践行共建“一带一路”倡议，推进食品安全国际协同治理。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: UNIDO food industry inspection and testing capacity building and improvement training program concludes
headlines.summary_en: The reporter learned today that the training program 'Quality Enhancement and Protection, Silk Road Mutual Trust' for food industry inspection and testing capacity building and improvement, jointly guided and implemented by the State Administration for Market Regulation (CNCA) and the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO), concluded in Beijing. headlines.title: 国家知识产权局副局长张志成会见中国美国商会会长一行
headlines.summary: 近日，中国国家知识产权局副局长张志成在京会见来访的中国美国商会会长何迈可和会员企业代表。张志成表示，近年来，中国依法严格保护国内外企业知识产权，做到一视同仁、同等保护，努力为各国企业和创新主体营造公平竞争的发展环境。中国国家知识产权局愿意倾听业界声音，了解外资企业在知识产权方面的需求，有针对性地做好相关工作。何迈可表示，近年来，中国知识产权保护取得长足进展，为外资企业发展提供了良好环境。中国美国商会希望与中国国家知识产权局继续保持沟通并将持续鼓励会员企业坚定信心，投资中国。

headlines.title_en: Zhang Zhicheng, Deputy Commissioner of the China National Intellectual Property Administration, met with a delegation led by the President of the American Chamber of Commerce in China
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Zhang Zhicheng, Deputy Commissioner of the China National Intellectual Property Administration, met in Beijing with Michael Hart, President of the American Chamber of Commerce in China, and representatives of member companies. Zhang Zhicheng stated that in recent years, China has strictly protected the intellectual property of domestic and foreign enterprises in accordance with the law, treating all equally and providing equal protection, striving to create a fair competitive development environment for enterprises and innovators of all countries. The CNIPA is willing to listen to industry voices, understand the IP needs of foreign-funded enterprises, and do relevant work in a targeted manner. Hart said that in recent years, China's IP protection has made significant progress, providing a good environment for the development of foreign-funded enterprises. AmCham China hopes to maintain communication with the CNIPA and will continue to encourage member companies to strengthen confidence and invest in China.

headlines.title: 日本央行数据显示 上周五干预汇市金额约340亿美元
headlines.summary: 据彭博对央行账户的分析，日本上周五可能在汇市投入约340亿美元以支撑日元，这是继前一天行动基础上的持续干预，并与美国进行了协调。此次操作规模估计约为5.33万亿日元（约合340亿美元）。日本财务大臣片山五月周一早些时候确认，日本上周五确实入市干预。美国财政部上周加入了支撑日元的行动，对日本央行账户的分析并未揭示美国在此次市场中干预的规模，但美国的参与可能减少了日本为达到相同汇率效果所需的资金投入。

headlines.title_en: Bank of Japan data shows Friday's intervention in currency market amounted to approximately $34 billion
headlines.summary_en: According to Bloomberg's analysis of central bank accounts, Japan likely spent about $34 billion in the foreign exchange market last Friday to support the yen, continuing intervention from the previous day's actions and coordinated with the United States. The operation is estimated at approximately 5.33 trillion yen (about $34 billion). Japan's Finance Minister Katsunobu Katayama confirmed earlier Monday that Japan did intervene in the market last Friday. The U.S. Treasury joined actions to support the yen last week, and the analysis of the Bank of Japan's accounts did not reveal the scale of U.S. intervention in this market, but U.S. participation may have reduced the funds Japan needed to spend to achieve the same exchange-rate effect.
